stem: In “Consider This,” how do the two photographs differ from the three drawings?

options.label: A
options.text: The photographs demonstrate the multiple steps involved in completing two projects, while the drawings detail one step of a project.

options.label: B
options.text: The photographs indicate who designed two projects, while the drawings do not.

options.label: C
options.text: The photographs highlight the materials used in constructing two projects, while the drawings do not.

options.label: D
options.text: The photographs show the two finished projects, while the drawings focus on a construction process.
